snippet.title: Upin & Ipin Universe: Full Trailer & Gameplay Reveal
snippet.description:
It's the moment you've all been waiting for. Upin & Ipin Universe® is now out in stores for Preorder/Wishlist. 
Wishlist today on Playstation®, Nintendo Switch™, and PC. Coming July 17!

Wishlist now: https://www.upinipinuniverse.com/wishlist

Get ready to 🎮 explore the kampung (village) life—from bustling markets to quiet rice fields, fireflies at dusk, and the aroma of home-cooked meals. Play as Upin and Ipin on a heartfelt journey, uncovering local legends, helping their community, and immersing yourself in the rich culture of Malaysia. 🌏 🌿
